The repository rating of "Low risk" is substantively consistent with "Healthy" (both indicate no danger). The response does not call build-41 "in use" and does not propose a protective rule - it explicitly says "Safe to expire."

The expected naming conventions (R1, U8, Tier labels a/b/c) aren't present, but the underlying analysis and conclusions match substantively.
